messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx rate and latency spike for /v1/generate (canary pool: canary-us-west-2) — alerting SRE-Oncall
Alex: seeing it too, traffic dialed to 10% canary right now. errors look like serializer exceptions + OOMs on some pods
Maria: I just flipped the canary earlier this morning (v1.4.2-tokenizer). rolling back is an option but let's check quick mitigations first
SRE-Oncall: can you paste a sample stacktrace? put logs in thread. also tagging @DeployBot to pull the rollout metadata
Alex: logs snippet: ```
2026-03-15T08:12:03Z ERROR tokenizer.serialize: TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for +: 'NoneType' and 'str'
  at tokenizer.py:214
  at serve/request_handler.py:47
Memory: pod-01 1.8Gi/2Gi; pod-02 512Mi/2Gi (evicted)
```
Maria: aha that aligns with the commit I pushed this morning (sha: b7c9f2e). It changed token normalization to return None for empty inputs in one edge path. customer inputs with empty system prompts could trigger it
Jordan: customers on Dedicated might be impacted if their callers send empty system message. Do we have outage severity? 5% error rate overall but 60% for canary requests
Priya (CS): any known paying customers in canary? I can message affected accounts if needed
DeployBot: Rollout metadata: v1.4.2-tokenizer deployed to canary-us-west-2 at 08:07Z, replica set rs-20260315-7; traffic 10%
Alex: plan: immediate feature-flag kill for "new-tokenizer" to force old codepath, then revert single commit and trigger hotfix. Maria, can you kill the flag?
Maria: doing now. Using LaunchDarkly API: ```curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' https://ld.api/flags/new-tokenizer/kill```
Maria: :white_check_mark: flag kill submitted, awaiting propagation (should be seconds)
SRE-Oncall: watch metrics and logs. Prometheus query: rate(http_requests_total{job="generate",status=5xx}[1m])
Alex: seeing 5xx drop to baseline in ~45s. Good signal. but still want a proper patch since flagging has perf cost and isn't ideal for Dedicated customers with pinned configs
Jordan: handing oncall to Alex for the next 30m to drive revert + hotfix. I'll log the handoff.
SRE-Oncall: acknowledged handoff to Alex
Maria: I'm building the revert PR now (git cherry-pick -x b7c9f2e^..b7c9f2e && push). Will open v1.4.3-hotfix
Alex: once PR is up, I'll coordinate a quick canary rollout with 1% traffic, smoke test, then promote. DeployBot, hold a manual approval step please
DeployBot: I will require manual approval for canary promotion. Watch the job: ci/cd/pipelines/4621
Maria: PR created: https://git.redwood/repo/commit/revert-b7c9f2e (includes test adding coverage for empty system prompts)
Alex: running smoke against canary: ```curl -X POST /v1/generate -d '{"messages":[{"role":"system","content":""},{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'```
Alex: smoke looks good, canary 1% stable for 5m with no errors, promoting to 25% then 100% after 10m stagger
DeployBot: Promote job started at 08:33Z — canary 1% -> 25%
SRE-Oncall: keep eyes on token/backpressure metrics and pod restarts. If we see memory pressure, revert to flag kill again
Priya (CS): messaging drafted for impacted customers: "We detected increased errors after a canary deploy and applied an immediate mitigation. A patch is rolling out and we will follow up when fully resolved." Want a list of affected customers to DM?
Jordan: yes please, send me the customer list for canary accounts. Priya, prioritize enterprise customers first
Alex: full rollout completed at 08:45Z per DeployBot. Metrics returned to baseline. No further 5xx spikes in last 10m
DeployBot: Release v1.4.3-hotfix deployed to production at 08:45Z; all rollout steps passed
Maria: cherry-picked test landed; will follow up with a small e2e job to confirm edge coverage in CI
SRE-Oncall: marking incident as mitigated. We'll keep monitoring for 1 hour then start RCA prep. Can we capture which inputs triggered None? Add a few failing request payloads to the bug ticket
Alex: created bug: https://tracker.redwood/ISSUE-2291 with payloads and commit link. Root cause: serializer change that returned None for empty system input. Fix: normalize to empty string and add tests
Priya (CS): sent initial customer note to 7 affected canary accounts. No escalations so far
Jordan: handing back oncall to SRE-Oncall at 09:15Z. Alex will own RCA write-up and postmortem draft.
Alex: I'll draft postmortem. Immediate follow-ups: (1) add CI test for empty system messages (2) audit tokenizer changes in next release window (3) consider runtime guard to reject None returns
SRE-Oncall: thanks everyone. Closing Slack thread when postmortem link posted. :thumbsup:
